response.justification: Despite extensive experience, Bogdan is overqualified and misaligned with the junior/mid-level scope; his senior titles, deep expertise in DLang and embedded systems, and lack of PostgreSQL/React/Nest.js focus contradict the role’s stack and industry context, while his basic German and high on-site requirement pose cultural/logistical risks.
strengths: Extensive full-stack TypeScript and Node.js experience across multiple roles
Proven ability to lead and ship complex web and data platforms
Strong open-source contributions and technical teaching background
concerns: Overqualified for junior/mid-level role, likely to be dissatisfied or leave quickly
Lacks explicit experience with required stack (PostgreSQL, React, Nest.js)
Basic German proficiency conflicts with high on-site requirement in Berlin
